source: GSAP 3.15.1 parseEase, recorded from the copy the film was first made with, before engine/motion.js replaced it
points: p = i/1000 for i = 0..1000; sha256 of the 1,001 values as float64 little-endian; every100: the values at i = 0, 100, ..., 1000
